summary: Iter 13 — Email click-tracking + 5-demo personalization + half-view idempotency. Backend 10/10 pytest pass. Frontend personalization renders correctly on all 5 demos (Realtor, Insurance, Creator, Noldus, SITA) — both Hero and StartScreen. Realtor heading correctly reads 'This walkthrough was prepared for Sarah.' Admin Demo Email Shares · Click-through section visible with 34 rows and stat cards (Sent/Queued/Clicked/Click Rate). Click-tracking redirect (302) preserves personalization params; click_count + first_clicked_at + last_clicked_at populate after first click. Half-view notification fires exactly ONCE on first ≥50% heartbeat, suppressed on subsequent calls. Graceful degradation works: RESEND_API_KEY empty → sent:false but tracked_url + share_id still returned. demo_type=sita is now accepted by ShareDemoRequest regex. Avatar-personal-greeting JSX wired correctly in RealtorDemoPage.jsx:1639 (gated on personalGreeting prop) — runtime visibility blocked only by the pre-existing 15-scene TTS prefetch latency (iter12 known issue). Without ?name param, all greetings gracefully don't render.

integration_issues.flow: AvatarPanel personal greeting visibility on Realtor/Insurance
integration_issues.issue: avatar-personal-greeting JSX is correctly wired (RealtorDemoPage.jsx:1638-1642, InsuranceDemoPage.jsx:1682) and gated on personalGreeting prop. Could NOT be verified at runtime within 90s because handleStart awaits prefetchAll() which sequentially fetches 15 TTS clips before scene 0 renders. This is the same prefetch-vs-setStarted ordering issue flagged in iter12 action_items #1. Not a regression — code path is correct. Recommend flipping setStarted(true) BEFORE awaiting prefetchAll() so scene 0 (and the avatar greeting) becomes visible immediately on click.

action_items: (NICE-TO-HAVE, carryover from iter12) In Realtor/Insurance/Creator handleStart, call setStarted(true) BEFORE awaiting prefetchAll() so scene 0 + avatar-personal-greeting become visible immediately on user click. Currently 15 TTS prefetches (~30-90s on slow networks) gate the demo open.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend share-demo endpoint (server.py:692) correctly logs ALL shares to demo_shares collection regardless of email send success — graceful degradation works as designed.

/api/r/{share_id} (server.py:773) correctly: finds share, $inc click_count, sets last_clicked_at, sets first_clicked_at only if absent (idempotent on field), records full audit entry in demo_share_clicks collection, then 302s to demo_url. Falls back to homepage on missing share_id.
_append_personalization helper (server.py:676) preserves existing query params and only adds name/company/email if absent — safe against double-personalization.

Half-view trigger (server.py:1604) uses 'progress_pct >= 50 AND not half_view_notified' — atomically idempotent because half_view_notified is set in same $set update before _maybe_queue_half_view_notification fires.

All 5 demo pages now consistently pass `personalization` prop into Hero and StartScreen (verified via grep). useDemoTracking emits {name, company, recipient_id, recipient_email, greeting} and gates session/start on the started flag.
AdminPage.jsx:393 admin-demo-shares table renders click_count column, stat cards (Sent/Queued/Clicked/Click Rate) — all 4 stat cards verified visible at runtime.

success_rate.frontend: ≈ 95% — personalization confirmed on all 5 demos, admin shares table confirmed, only avatar-greeting runtime visibility blocked by known prefetch latency (code wiring verified)

Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_share_tracking.py is reusable as regression suite. Only carryover nit is the prefetch-await pattern in handleStart on Realtor/Insurance/Creator — recommend reordering to fire-and-forget for click-tracking accuracy.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects in iter13. The single integration concern (avatar-greeting runtime visibility) is a pre-existing UX latency (handleStart awaits 15 sequential TTS prefetches before opening scene 0). Code wiring is correct: AvatarPanel JSX gated on personalGreeting prop; useDemoTracking computes greeting from ?name=&company=. Mitigation: setStarted(true) BEFORE awaiting prefetchAll() so scene 0 (and the avatar greeting) become visible at click time, then prefetch streams audio in the background.
